item.title: Airports Authority explains major delays at Ben Gurion Airport
item.description:
The Israel Airports Authority rejected reports of a staffing shortage at Ben Gurion International Airport, saying the delays were caused, among other factors, by heavy air traffic, restrictions in European airspace, and flights by American refueling aircraft.
According to the authority, an unusually large backlog of approximately 90 flights accumulated within three hours, while around 90,000 passengers are expected to pass through the airport today.

item.title: Ebola concern in Israel ruled out
item.description:
The Health Ministry announced that tests for Ebola conducted on a person who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo after being suspected of contracting the virus came back negative.
The ministry stressed that, at this time, no confirmed case of Ebola has been diagnosed in Israel.

item.title: Report: China suspected of funding anti-Israel protests in UK
item.description:
American politicians are examining suspicions of covert Chinese funding for the activities of Code Pink in Britain, which has held pro-Palestinian demonstrations in the country, according to a report in The Telegraph.
As part of the investigation, payments totaling approximately £250,000 to a company linked to the organization are being examined. The funds were allegedly received from companies connected to technology mogul Neville Roy Singham.

item.title: Maariv poll: Coalition drops to 48 seats
item.description:
A Maariv poll published on Friday morning shows the coalition bloc weakening by one seat this week, standing at just 48 seats. The coalition's decline is a direct result of Likud losing one seat, dropping to 21.
Seat breakdown in the poll: Yashar (led by Eisenkot) 23, Likud 21, Together (led by Bennett) 14, Yisrael Beytenu 10, The Democrats 10, Otzma Yehudit 8, United Torah Judaism 8, Shas 7, Hadash-Ta'al 6, Ra'am 5, Religious Zionist party 4, Zionist Home (led by Tropper and Hendel) 4.
The Zionist opposition bloc reaches 57 seats, and together with Chili Tropper and Yoaz Hendel could form a majority of 61 seats. The Arab parties account for an additional 11 seats.
